units.source_text: 什么晚上在祇园樱花树下生的，不是有点像《竹取物语》这个民间故事了吗？

en.t: Being born at night under the cherry trees in Gion does sound a little like the folktale The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, does it not?

units.source_text: 据说赫映姬就是从竹节之间生出来的。

en.t: They say Princess Kaguya was born from between the joints of a bamboo stalk.
